label: Sitiawan house break-in damage

sequence: Entry by night through the front: the grille padlock hasp cut and the main door lock forced
The intruders search the master bedroom, break the wardrobe mirror doors and take jewellery and cash
The intruders throw the television to the floor and spray paint on the living room wall before leaving

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on the night of 8 to 9 March 2025 falls inside 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: housebreaking and theft by intruders at night, with no intervening event. Theft is insured nowhere in the policy. The FP512A malicious damage extension excludes loss or damage arising out of or in the course of burglary, housebreaking or theft, so the damage done by the intruders in its course is not brought in either.

must_not_cite.reason: It addresses theft during or after a fire. There was no fire; citing it is the wrong ground.
The non-residential variant; not held and not the right variant for a dwelling.
The family was away two nights; the house was not unoccupied for more than 30 days.
No disturbance of the public peace; the riot and strike limbs of FP512A are not engaged.

counterfactual.reason: No basis to price. Housebreaking and theft are insured nowhere in the policy, and the malicious damage done in its course is excluded by FP512A, so there is no cover to quantify at any figure.
